'''Zark Leader''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] attributed to the lead [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of [[Zark Squadron]], a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy's]] [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force|Expansionary Defense Fleet]].<ref name="Swarm War" />
